<function name="LookupKeyBinding" parent="input" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Returns the bind string that the given key is bound to.</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="key" type="number{BUTTON_CODE}">Key from <page>Enums/BUTTON_CODE</page></arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="string">The bind string of the given key.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
